summary: Tiny Tiny RSS is a web-based application designed to aggregate and read RSS and Atom news feeds. It runs on your own infrastructure, allowing you to collect and manage subscriptions to various web feeds from a central interface. As a self-hosted feed reader, it keeps your reading habits and subscription lists under your direct control.
goodFor: It is a solid fit for technical users who want to move away from commercial, cloud-based news readers and prefer hosting their own data.
watchOut: The project relies on a rolling development model without tagged releases, which can make tracking specific versions or stability milestones less predictable.
deployNotes: Because it is built with PHP and packaged for Docker, you will typically need to provision persistent storage for your database and feeds, alongside a standard reverse proxy for TLS termination.
